DHCPD_DEFAULT.description: Path to the init script defaults file (source'd before start/stop).

DHCPDv4_CONF.description: Path to IPv4 DHCP server configuration file.

DHCPDv6_CONF.description: Path to IPv6 DHCP server configuration file.

DHCPDv4_PID.description: PID file path for the IPv4 DHCP daemon.

DHCPDv6_PID.description: PID file path for the IPv6 DHCP daemon.

DOMAIN_NAME_SERVERS.description: List of DNS servers to offer to DHCP clients.

DOMAIN_NAME.description: Domain name to offer to DHCP clients.

ROUTERS.description: Default router (gateway) to offer to DHCP clients.

SUBNET_MASK.description: Subnet mask to offer to DHCP clients.

RANGE_START.description: Start of the IP address range for dynamic allocation.

RANGE_END.description: End of the IP address range for dynamic allocation.

DDNS_UPDATE_STYLE.description: Style of DNS update (ad-hoc, interim, or none).
